title: Candlestick patterns: do a hammer or a bullish engulfing after a fall, or a bearish engulfing or a doji after a rise, predict the next 5-20 sessions on liquid stocks?
hypothesis: The classic reading: a hammer or a bullish engulfing candle after a decline marks a turn up (better returns ahead, worth buying at the next open); a bearish engulfing candle or a doji after a rise marks a turn down (worse returns ahead).

data.stocks: gold/teachers/stock_panel.parquet (adjusted daily open/high/low/close, 2000-01-03 to 2023-12-29); events and base = liquidity rank 1-250 that day
data.nothing_sealed: no 2024+ row; nothing was looked at for outcomes before this spec

definitions.body, range, shadows: body = |close - open|; range = high - low (must be > 0); lower shadow = min(open, close) - low; upper shadow = high - max(open, close)
definitions.prior move: the 5-session return to YESTERDAY's close (close[t-1] / close[t-6] - 1), continuous sessions only; a decline is <= -3%, a rise >= +3%
definitions.hammer: lower shadow >= 2 x body, upper shadow <= 25% of the range, after a decline
definitions.bullish engulfing: yesterday red (close < open), today green; today's open <= yesterday's close and today's close >= yesterday's open; today's body larger; after a decline
definitions.bearish engulfing: yesterday green, today red; today's open >= yesterday's close and today's close <= yesterday's open; today's body larger; after a rise
definitions.doji after a rise: body <= 10% of the range, after a rise
definitions.events: one per stock per 10 sessions; the pattern is known at the close, so every outcome starts at the NEXT session's open

outcomes.fwd5 / fwd20: the panel's fwd5 / fwd20: close 5 / 20 sessions later divided by the next open, minus 1 (windows with a one-day move over 50% skipped)
outcomes.trade20: the panel's net20: fwd20 minus the round-trip cost column (delivery plus the spread estimate by liquidity rank)

statistics.vs ordinary days (fwd5, fwd20): india.teachers_stock.level: event mean minus the mean of the base (every 5th session of every liquid-250 stock, plus the events) in the same quarter, t across quarters
statistics.the trade itself (trade20): india.teachers_stock.absolute: the events' own mean net return, quarter means (this includes the market's drift; the vs-ordinary rows say whether the pattern adds anything)
statistics.periods: development to 2017, validation 2018-2023; nothing from 2024 on, no sealed folder
statistics.verdict: india/registry.record standard rule; 16 blocks per period

bar.note: family 'technical' (XO1 27 + SR1 11 = 38) plus these 8; k frozen at 46
